versions.changelog:
- Initial release of fund-analysis skill ("火富牛综合基金分析技能") for comprehensive analysis of both private (私募) and public (公募) funds.
- Supports workflows for NAV trend analysis, performance metrics, holdings, fund screening, and FOF/portfolio analysis.
- Integrates detailed workflows with fof99 MCP data platform APIs and adopts ECharts for rich data visualization.
- Follows the 火富牛 professional visual identity system: red-based palette, white backgrounds, and card-style layouts suitable for financial analysis.
- Designed usage triggers, recommended data flows, and standardized presentation for fund discovery, comparison, and reporting.
